description: Test cases for rules skill covering Write, CLEAR, CQS, ASSESS, and RESOLVE routes

test_cases.description: Create Agent SI from roster specification
test_cases.input: Agent: W02-QA-Auditor, Tier 3, responsible for curriculum quality checks. Workflows: audit-curriculum.md. KB: KB/domain/quality-standards/
test_cases.expected_output: Agent SI with 7 Canonical sections, MANDATORY RAG OBLIGATION tag, valid I/O contract, handoff to Coordinator
test_cases.pass_criteria: File passes CQS size gate (>1.5KB), has all 7 sections, KB paths exist, workflow references valid

test_cases.description: Batch audit all Agent SIs and produce scorecard
test_cases.input: Scan .agents/agents/ containing 6 Agent SIs across Tiers 2-4
test_cases.expected_output: Scorecard with 7-dimension scores per Agent SI, Health Score, Priority Queue
test_cases.pass_criteria: All 6 agents scored across A1-A7, grades assigned, HPRF tier cross-referenced with .agents/agents.md

test_cases.description: Detect KB connectivity failure in Agent SI
test_cases.input: Agent SI references KB/domain/market-analysis.md but file doesn't exist on disk
test_cases.expected_output: A3 score penalized -5, flagged as broken KB link, recommended Protocol AR3
test_cases.pass_criteria: Broken link explicitly identified with path, penalty correctly applied, repair protocol mapped

test_cases.description: Repair Agent SI with missing handoff and I/O contract
test_cases.input: Agent SI scoring 52/100 (D): A5=2/15 (no I/O), A6=0/15 (no handoff), A3=5/15 (generic KB ref)
test_cases.expected_output: I/O contract generated from workflow analysis (AR5), handoff protocol from Interaction Matrix (AR6), KB paths resolved (AR3). Delta: D→B
test_cases.pass_criteria: Post-repair score ≥70, delta report shows per-dimension improvement, all protocols traceable

test_cases.description: Score rule file using full CLEAR framework
test_cases.input: Rule file with vague language ('handle appropriately'), no examples, no HPRF block
test_cases.expected_output: CLEAR score 1/5 (only Leveled passes). Specific failures: C=0 (3 vague terms found), E=0 (no examples), R=0 (no HPRF)
test_cases.pass_criteria: All 5 CLEAR dimensions scored individually, evidence provided per dimension, repair protocols RR1+RR3 recommended

test_cases.description: Refuse to delete actively-wired rule without human confirmation
test_cases.input: Orphan analysis (RR5) identifies rule file, but grep reveals 2 agents reference it in their SIs
test_cases.expected_output: HALT: file is NOT an orphan despite appearing unused in workflows. Show grep evidence. Cancel RR5.
test_cases.pass_criteria: Agent runs grep before deletion, discovers active references, cancels RR5, reports false positive
